problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 68 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 31 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 57 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 45 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 47 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 46 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 52 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 48 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 53 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 69 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 42 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 33 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 51 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Load all packages using the fewest trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total volume of packages on any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
